$comment: Settings for dsh-plugin-git-commit-push. This JSON file is the ONLY configuration channel: the plugin declares no Config schema, so DSH's Settings page shows no form for it (that feature was removed — it never appeared on the supported profiles). Copy it to <DSH_HOME>/git-commit-push.config.json (default ~/.dsh/git-commit-push.config.json) to override this shipped template. The next tool call or /git-commit-push run picks changes up — no DSH restart. Omitted keys keep the built-in defaults; a malformed file is reported in the result card rather than ignored.
